summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LINKED DOCUMENT FLOW for Purchase (PO → GRN → Invoice → Payment) and Selling (SO → DN → Invoice → Payment). All 21 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Both Buying and Selling pages show linked flow navigation with arrows, pending sections with action buttons, and full lifecycle completion with JE posting.
passed_tests: PURCHASE FLOW - API Health Check: GET /api/ returns Kairos Accounting API v2.0.0
PURCHASE FLOW - Create PO: POST /api/purchase/orders returns po_number (PO-*), vendor, items, grand_total with status=Submitted, grn_status=Pending
PURCHASE FLOW - Pending GRN: GET /api/purchase/grn/pending returns POs with status Draft/Submitted
PURCHASE FLOW - Confirm Receipt: POST /api/purchase/grn/from-po/{id} creates GRN with GRN number, posts JE (DR RM Inventory, DR GST Input, CR AP)
PURCHASE FLOW - After GRN: PO status becomes 'To Invoice' and grn_status becomes 'Received'
PURCHASE FLOW - Pending Invoice: GET /api/purchase/invoices/pending returns GRNs with invoice_status=Pending
PURCHASE FLOW - Create Invoice from GRN: POST /api/purchase/invoices/from-grn/{id} creates invoice with PI number
PURCHASE FLOW - Outstanding: GET /api/purchase/payments/outstanding returns unpaid invoices with days_outstanding and balance_due
PURCHASE FLOW - Pay Invoice: POST /api/purchase/payments/for-invoice/{id} posts JE (DR AP, CR Bank) and updates invoice to Paid
PURCHASE FLOW - Invoice marked Paid: Invoice status=Paid, amount_paid matches grand_total
SELLING FLOW - Create SO: POST /api/selling/sales-orders returns so_number (SO-*), customer, items, grand_total with status=Submitted
SELLING FLOW - Pending DN: GET /api/selling/delivery-notes/pending returns SOs with delivery_status='Not Delivered'
SELLING FLOW - Confirm Delivery: POST /api/selling/delivery-notes/from-so/{id} creates DN with DN number
SELLING FLOW - After DN: SO status becomes 'To Invoice' and delivery_status becomes 'Fully Delivered'
SELLING FLOW - Pending Sales Invoice: GET /api/selling/invoices/pending returns DNs with invoice_status=Pending
SELLING FLOW - Create Invoice from DN: POST /api/selling/invoices/from-dn/{id} creates invoice with SI number, posts Revenue+COGS+GST JE
SELLING FLOW - Outstanding AR: GET /api/selling/payments/outstanding returns unpaid invoices with days_outstanding and balance_due
SELLING FLOW - Receive Payment: POST /api/selling/payments/for-invoice/{id} posts JE (DR Bank, CR AR)
SELLING FLOW - Sales Invoice marked Paid: Invoice status=Paid, amount_paid matches grand_total
SELLING FLOW - SO Completed: SO status becomes 'Completed' and billing_status becomes 'Fully Billed'
